decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed first floor rear extension would harm the appearance of the building and the surrounding area and would appear obtrusive and out of character with the building which would be inconsistent with the Residential Extension Guidelines and contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations).

Condition : 2 - The extension would restrict sunlight and daylight access to first floor windows in adjoining buildings and would result in an unacceptable sense of enclosure to and loss of outlook from those windows causing harm to living conditions at these adjoining sites which would be inconsistent with the Residential Extension Guidelines and contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations).
description: Erection of a part two storey part single storey rear extension to shop
